user.title: Smart Ventilation – Add room
user.description: Optional: select the HA area that corresponds to this room. This pre-fills the room name in the next step and restricts the sensor/device selection lists to the entities assigned to that area. Leave empty to choose from all entities as before.

room.title: Smart Ventilation – Add room
room.description: Set up monitoring for one room. If an HA area was selected in the previous step, the room name is already pre-filled from it and the sensor/device selection lists below are already restricted to the entities assigned to that area (domains without a matching entity in the area remain unrestricted). Repeat this flow for additional rooms (Settings → Devices & Services → Add integration). Cross-room defaults live under the automatically created "Smart Ventilation Options" entry (Configure).

notify.name: Notification methods
notify.description: Enable the Home Assistant Companion App via the checkbox; the field directly below is only relevant if the checkbox is enabled. Voice announcement is active as soon as at least one speaker is selected.

data_description.mobile_targets: Empty = use the global targets from "Smart Ventilation Options". One or more notify entities. Each entry can optionally have a person or device_tracker entity - that target then only receives the push notification if the person/device is home. Without a presence entity, it is always sent. Currently global: {global_mobile_targets}
data_description.persistent_enabled: Empty = use the global setting from "Smart Ventilation Options". Currently global: {global_persistent_enabled}
data_description.mobile_enabled: Empty = use the global setting from "Smart Ventilation Options". Currently global: {global_mobile_enabled}
data_description.sonos_entity: Empty = no voice announcement for this room
data_description.tts_volume: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_tts_volume}

sensors.name: Sensors & Devices
sensors.description: Which entities provide the measurements for this room, and which devices (dehumidifier, air conditioner, heating) are controlled automatically?

data.heating_use_temp_source: Also use temperature source for heating
data.min_surplus_power_watts: Minimum surplus power to turn on
data.power_grace_period_minutes: Delay before turning off due to insufficient surplus power

data_description.temperature_source_entity: A climate, sensor, number or input_number entity
data_description.temperature_attribute: Only relevant if a climate entity was selected above
data_description.shower_detection_enabled: Delays the open-window recommendation due to humidity while it is currently rising quickly (typical while showering) - venting during the shower itself doesn't help, since steam keeps being produced. Only relevant for rooms with a shower/bath, no extra sensor needed (uses the humidity sensor selected above). The rise threshold for this lives in the "Parameters" section
data_description.co2_entity: A sensor entity with a CO2 value in ppm. Unlike temperature/humidity, there is no outdoor comparison for this - ventilating always helps when CO2 is high
data_description.shutter_entity: Optional: a cover entity (open/close) or a switch entity (1 = lowered+locked, 0 = raised+unlocked). Activated when the air conditioner turns on, deactivated again when it turns off
data_description.disable_close_recommendation: No "please close" recommendation is ever made for this room (temperature/humidity/CO2/winter max duration/summer case have no effect) - useful when the window contact doesn't reliably reflect the actual state (e.g. a sliding door) or an air conditioner handles cooling independently of the window. Frost/heat protection are unaffected and still close immediately. Open recommendations are unaffected too.
data_description.no_window: On: open/close notifications are never generated - useful for windowless hallways/basement rooms where only the dehumidifier/air conditioner should be controlled based on sensor readings. Device control keeps working regardless of this setting.
data_description.dehumidifier_entity: A switch or humidifier entity. Turns on at high, off at low humidity
data_description.dehumidifier_tank_full_entity: Optional: a binary_sensor that reports "on" when the tank is full or there is a fault - shown on the dashboard card as an addition to the dehumidifier status (e.g. "error")
data_description.ac_entity: A climate or switch entity. Turns on when it's too warm indoors and ventilating wouldn't help
data_description.heating_use_temp_source: Automatically uses the indoor temperature source selected above as the heating device, instead of selecting a second, separate entity in the "Heating" field - only effective if the temperature source is actually a climate entity (otherwise treated as "no heating configured"). When enabled, the "Heating" field below is ignored.
data_description.heating_entity: A climate entity. Switches between a comfort and a standby setpoint ("Parameters" section) instead of simply turning on/off - the usual way heating is operated. Also falls back to standby while the window is confirmed open. Ignored if "Also use temperature source for heating" above is enabled.
data_description.min_surplus_power_watts: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Only applies to turning on, never to turning off. Currently global: {global_min_surplus_power_watts}
data_description.power_grace_period_minutes: Empty = use the value from the global settings. A running device is only turned off for insufficient power once it has stayed low for this long. Currently global: {global_power_grace_period_minutes}

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: Optional - overrides the global settings for this room. Left empty, the value stored there applies (Settings → Devices & Services → Smart Ventilation Options → Configure).

data_description.temp_threshold_open: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_temp_threshold_open}
data_description.temp_threshold_close: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_temp_threshold_close}
data_description.humidity_threshold_open: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_humidity_threshold_open}
data_description.humidity_threshold_close: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_humidity_threshold_close}
data_description.co2_threshold_open: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_co2_threshold_open}
data_description.co2_threshold_close: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Currently global: {global_co2_threshold_close}
data_description.temp_margin: Tolerance used for outdoor/indoor temperature comparisons, to avoid the recommendation flickering. Currently global: {global_temp_margin}
data_description.frost_protection_temp: Below this outdoor temperature, opening is never recommended; an open state is closed immediately. Currently global: {global_frost_protection_temp}
data_description.frost_debounce_minutes: Minimum duration the outdoor temperature must stay continuously at/below the frost protection limit, OR the outdoor sensor must stay continuously unavailable, before an open state is actually closed because of it - protects against a single outlier reading and against brief sensor unavailability at startup. 0 = close immediately without delay. Currently global: {global_frost_debounce_minutes}
data_description.heat_protection_temp: Above this outdoor temperature, opening is never recommended; an open state is closed immediately - regardless of whether the room actually needs ventilating due to temperature, humidity or CO2. Currently global: {global_heat_protection_temp}
data_description.winter_outdoor_threshold: Below this outdoor temperature, conditions are considered "winter" (enables the max duration limit). Currently global: {global_winter_outdoor_threshold}
data_description.max_open_duration_winter_minutes: Under "winter" conditions, closing is recommended automatically after this duration. Currently global: {global_max_open_duration_winter_minutes}
data_description.reminder_interval_minutes: Recurring reminder if the recommendation is ignored. 0 = disabled. Currently global: {global_reminder_interval_minutes}
data_description.humidity_priority_over_duration: Empty = use the global setting. Determines whether a still-active humidity or CO2 ventilation need takes priority when the winter max duration is reached (window stays open) or whether the max duration is enforced strictly (window closes anyway). Frost protection always takes priority regardless. Currently global: {global_humidity_priority_over_duration}
data_description.shower_rise_threshold: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Only relevant if shower detection is enabled in the "Sensors" section. Currently global: {global_shower_rise_threshold}
data_description.heating_threshold_temp: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Below this indoor temperature, heating switches to the comfort setpoint; once threshold + tolerance margin is reached again, it switches back to standby. Currently global: {global_heating_threshold_temp}
data_description.heating_comfort_temp: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Setpoint applied once the indoor temperature drops below the heating threshold. Currently global: {global_heating_comfort_temp}
data_description.heating_standby_temp: Empty = use the value from the global settings. Setpoint applied once the indoor temperature reaches the threshold again, or while the window is open. Currently global: {global_heating_standby_temp}

data_description.area_id: HA area for this room - restricts the sensor/device selection lists below to the entities assigned to this area (domains without a matching entity in the area remain unrestricted). After changing this, save once - the selection lists are then shown updated for the new area, and anything else you already entered is kept; a second save applies the changes for good. Leave empty to choose from all entities as before.

global.title: Edit Smart Ventilation Options
global.description: These values act as the default for every room that doesn't override the respective field itself.

data_description.reset_to_defaults: When saved, resets all thresholds in the "Parameters" section and all notification message texts in the "Notification texts" section to their built-in defaults - regardless of what is currently entered in those fields. Selected entities (sensors, TTS, power sensor, notification targets) as well as the voice playback mode and notification methods are unaffected.

sensors.name: Sensors
sensors.description: Sensors and playback settings as the room-wide default.

data.min_surplus_power_watts: Minimum surplus power to turn on
data.power_grace_period_minutes: Delay before turning off due to insufficient surplus power

data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Used for all rooms - can no longer be overridden per room
data_description.outdoor_humidity_entity: Used for all rooms, cannot be overridden per room. Without this sensor, ventilating on high indoor humidity is still recommended regardless of outdoor conditions. With it set, humidity-based ventilation is only recommended if it's actually drier outside than inside
data_description.tts_entity: Used when a room doesn't set its own TTS entity
data_description.tts_volume: Volume the speakers are set to before the announcement (not automatically restored afterwards)
data_description.tts_playback_mode: "Overlay" plays the announcement directly over any running playback. "Pause" pauses it first (not automatically resumed afterwards)
data_description.power_entity: Used when a room doesn't set its own power sensor
data_description.min_surplus_power_watts: Default minimum threshold for all rooms without their own setting
data_description.power_grace_period_minutes: Default delay for all rooms without their own setting
data_description.mobile_targets: One or more notify entities. Each entry can optionally have a person or device_tracker entity - that target then only receives the push notification if the person/device is home. Without a presence entity, it is always sent.
data_description.persistent_enabled: Creates a persistent notification in the Home Assistant notification panel while the recommendation is active - automatically dismissed once it's resolved

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: These thresholds act as the room-wide default.

data.humidity_priority_over_duration: Humidity/CO2 take priority over winter max duration

data_description.co2_threshold_open: Common recommendation: ventilate at 1000 ppm at the latest
data_description.temp_margin: Tolerance used for outdoor/indoor temperature comparisons, to avoid the recommendation flickering
data_description.frost_protection_temp: Below this outdoor temperature, opening is never recommended; an open state is closed immediately
data_description.frost_debounce_minutes: Minimum duration the outdoor temperature must stay continuously at/below the frost protection limit, OR the outdoor sensor must stay continuously unavailable, before an open state is actually closed because of it - protects against a single outlier reading and against brief sensor unavailability at startup. 0 = close immediately without delay
data_description.heat_protection_temp: Above this outdoor temperature, opening is never recommended; an open state is closed immediately - regardless of whether the room actually needs ventilating due to temperature, humidity or CO2
data_description.winter_outdoor_threshold: Below this outdoor temperature, conditions are considered "winter" (enables the max duration limit)
data_description.max_open_duration_winter_minutes: Under "winter" conditions, closing is recommended automatically after this duration
data_description.reminder_interval_minutes: Recurring reminder if the recommendation is ignored. 0 = disabled
data_description.humidity_priority_over_duration: On (default): if humidity or CO2 still needs ventilating, the winter max duration is ignored and the window stays open. Off: the max duration is enforced strictly, even at high humidity/CO2. Frost protection always takes priority regardless.
data_description.shower_rise_threshold: Humidity rise (percentage points per minute, measured over the last 10 minutes) above which an ongoing shower is assumed - only relevant for rooms that enabled shower detection in the "Sensors" section
data_description.heating_threshold_temp: Below this indoor temperature, heating switches to the comfort setpoint; once threshold + tolerance margin is reached again, it switches back to standby
data_description.heating_comfort_temp: Setpoint applied once the indoor temperature drops below the heating threshold
data_description.heating_standby_temp: Setpoint applied once the indoor temperature reaches the threshold again, or while the window is open

messages.name: Notification texts
messages.description: The texts sent for the respective recommendations. Three placeholders are available: ｛raum｝ (room name), ｛wert｝ (current measured value, including unit) and ｛schwelle｝ (the matching threshold, including unit).

data.msg_close_duration: Close due to winter max duration
data.msg_close_outdoor_wetter: Close because it's more humid outside

data_description.msg_open_humidity: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current humidity, ｛schwelle｝ = humidity threshold to open (each incl. %).
data_description.msg_open_co2: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current CO2 value, ｛schwelle｝ = CO2 threshold to open (each incl. ppm).
data_description.msg_open_temp: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current indoor temperature, ｛schwelle｝ = temperature threshold to open (each incl. °C).
data_description.msg_close_default: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current indoor temperature, ｛schwelle｝ = temperature threshold to close (each incl. °C) - used e.g. when temperature alone triggers closing.
data_description.msg_close_humidity: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current humidity, ｛schwelle｝ = humidity threshold to close (each incl. %).
data_description.msg_close_co2: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current CO2 value, ｛schwelle｝ = CO2 threshold to close (each incl. ppm).
data_description.msg_close_frost: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current outdoor temperature, ｛schwelle｝ = frost protection limit (each incl. °C).
data_description.msg_close_heat: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current outdoor temperature, ｛schwelle｝ = heat protection limit (each incl. °C).
data_description.msg_close_duration: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = time open so far, ｛schwelle｝ = winter max duration (each incl. minutes).
data_description.msg_close_outdoor_warmer: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current outdoor temperature, ｛schwelle｝ = current indoor temperature (each incl. °C).
data_description.msg_close_outdoor_wetter: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝ = current absolute outdoor humidity, ｛schwelle｝ = current absolute indoor humidity (each incl. g/m³).
data_description.msg_reminder: ｛raum｝ = room name. ｛wert｝/｛schwelle｝ = current value and open threshold of the original ventilation reason (temperature/humidity/CO2), each incl. its unit.
